g.text: TRANSFER THE MECHANISM
Six company mechanisms translate
into reusable engineering practices
Bridgewater / evidence packages
Task-specific knowledge and time scoping support
relevant evidence and concise human briefs.
Kepler / grounded numbers
Typed facts, code arithmetic and citation checks
attach meaning and lineage to material numbers.
Range / expert-authored skills
Domain specialists encode the professional method:
reasons, questions, exceptions and review.
Ramp / end-to-end evaluation
Compare one context, skill, memory or model change
at a time using complete tasks and ablations.
Two Sigma / Wise / authority
Give tools scoped ownership and explicit permission
to act; context alone grants no authority.
Contour / useful work
Compare acceptance, review effort and full cost
against a credible alternative.
Synthesis of conference mechanisms; grouping is our application framework. Company implementations do not establish local ROI.
Session links and primary technical guidance: reference page 28.
